output_json.diff_review: patch_only.diff changes two files. ArchiveAnalyzer.java: after `final File file = new File(destination, entry.getName())`, adds `if (!isInsideDestination(file, destination)) throw new ArchiveExtractionException(...)` guarding the mkdirs (line 527) and extractAcceptedFile/FileOutputStream (line 532) sinks flagged at trace lines 518/542-543/547. New helper isInsideDestination compares getCanonicalPath() and requires canonicalFile.equals(canonicalDest) or startsWith(canonicalDest + File.separator) — correctly avoids the sibling-prefix false-negative; IOException is treated as unsafe (returns false/reject). The existing extractFiles wrapper logs and swallows ArchiveExtractionException, so malicious archives are skipped rather than aborting the scan, and benign nested directories still extract. ArchiveAnalyzerTest.java only adds a regression test (testZipSlipIsBlocked) plus imports — no production logic changed. The pov.diff adds only files under .security-pipeline/ and does not alter the POV between before/after runs. No unrelated or broad behavior added; no test-only masking of the fix.
issues: Minor: the added regression test testZipSlipIsBlocked is gated by the pre-existing assumeFalse(isPreviouslyLoaded(...)) pattern and appears as skipped in a full-suite run, so it does not always execute; the standalone POV remains the reliable behavioral check.
output_json.pov_result: Independently reran `bash .security-pipeline/pov/run_pov.sh` via the Docker wrapper against the patched worktree: exit code 1, output "target written = false" / "NOT VULNERABLE: no file was written outside the extraction directory." Orchestrator's pre-patch run showed exit 0 with "target written = true / VULNERABLE." The POV drives the genuine private ArchiveAnalyzer.extractFiles via reflection with Engine.accept() overridden to true, so the fix — not a disabled exploit — is what blocks the traversal.
output_json.regression_result: Independently reran `mvn -B -pl core test -Dtest=ArchiveAnalyzerTest`: exit 0, BUILD SUCCESS, Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0 (1 skipped via the pre-existing isPreviouslyLoaded assumeFalse guard). Orchestrator's `mvn -B -pl core -am -DskipTests install` also succeeded. Minor caveat: the newly added testZipSlipIsBlocked can be skipped by the class's isPreviouslyLoaded guard, but the standalone POV authoritatively confirms the blocked behavior.
output_json.summary: The patch adds a canonical-path containment check to ArchiveAnalyzer.extractArchive that rejects any archive entry resolving outside the destination directory before any directory creation or file write, fixing the Zip Slip / CWE-022 path traversal. The fix is minimal and appropriate, the POV no longer reproduces (exit 1, file not written outside destination), and regression build/tests pass. The POV itself is untouched by the patch.
